description: Rewrite the repo-root Unraid.md for the two-container (bot + sidecar) deployment and update the repo-root README.md to match the new architecture. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 because it documents their env vars, build subdirs, and the removal of the bot's native voice deps.
steps: Rewrite f:\git\jaina-proudmoore\Unraid.md (keep it at the repo ROOT - one file is cleaner for a two-service setup than splitting). Document: build BOTH images from GitHub source on Unraid using the existing clone-then-build SSH-deploy-key pattern - bot from the JainaProudmoore subdir (`docker build --pull -t jaina-proudmoore /tmp/jaina/JainaProudmoore`), sidecar from the JainaVoiceSidecar subdir (`docker build --pull -t jaina-voice-sidecar /tmp/jaina/JainaVoiceSidecar`). Put both containers on a shared Docker network so the bot reaches the sidecar by container name jaina-voice-sidecar. Env vars - bot: TOKEN, DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT, GEMINI_API_KEY, Bot__SidecarBaseUrl=http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080, optional Bot__SidecarToken; sidecar: TOKEN (same bot token - Discord permits a second connection), PORT (default 8080), optional SIDECAR_TOKEN (must equal the bot's Bot__SidecarToken). State that no ports need publishing externally.

In Unraid.md remove the entire DAVE-PR-3288 / patched-Discord.Net blockquote and any mention of building Discord.Net from source. Update the native-deps paragraph: the bot no longer needs ffmpeg/libopus/libsodium/libdave; the SIDECAR image bundles ffmpeg + libdave. Add a short WHY: Discord.Net could not reliably SEND under Discord's mandatory DAVE E2EE, so the Go sidecar owns DAVE voice while the bot keeps the gateway + slash commands.

Update f:\git\jaina-proudmoore\README.md: the 'Native runtime dependencies' section (bot no longer needs libopus/libsodium/ffmpeg) and the /askjaina description (it delegates audio playback to the voice sidecar). Keep all other sections intact and consistent with Unraid.md and JainaVoiceSidecar/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Unraid.md documents two containers on a shared network, both built from their correct GitHub subdirs via the clone-then-build pattern, with the exact env vars for each service and a note that no external ports are published.
No DAVE-PR-3288 / patched-Discord.Net references remain in Unraid.md or README.md; `grep -rn "DAVE-PR-3288" Unraid.md README.md` returns nothing.
README.md native-deps and /askjaina sections match the new sidecar architecture and are consistent with Unraid.md and the sidecar README.
Env var names in the docs exactly match FEAT-001 (TOKEN/PORT/SIDECAR_TOKEN) and FEAT-002 (Bot__SidecarBaseUrl/Bot__SidecarToken).
verification: Manual read-through: build commands name JainaProudmoore and JainaVoiceSidecar subdirs; env var names match the sidecar and bot; shared-network/container-name reachability described.
findings:
REWROTE the repo-root docs for the two-container (bot + sidecar) architecture.

== Unraid.md (full rewrite) ==
- Opens by naming both containers: jaina-proudmoore (.NET gateway + slash commands, no longer connects voice) and jaina-voice-sidecar (Go send-only DAVE voice). WHY paragraph: Discord.Net could not reliably SEND under mandatory DAVE E2EE, so the Go sidecar owns DAVE voice while the bot keeps gateway + slash commands.
- Removed the ENTIRE DAVE-PR-3288 / patched-Discord.Net blockquote and all from-source Discord.Net build mentions (no more dev-branch commit, PR #3288/#2873/#3263, FinishConnectAudio guard, local NuGet feed, EnableVoiceDaveEncryption). Removed the old 4017 close-code note.
- Native-deps section rewritten: the BOT image needs no ffmpeg/libopus/libsodium/libdave.so (stock Discord.Net 3.20.2 from nuget.org); the SIDECAR image bundles ffmpeg + pinned libdave.so.
- Build section builds BOTH images from one clone via the clone-then-build SSH-deploy-key pattern: `rm -rf /tmp/jaina && git clone --depth 1 -b master git@github.com:kristoffer-tvera/jaina-proudmoore.git /tmp/jaina`, then `docker build --pull -t jaina-proudmoore /tmp/jaina/JainaProudmoore` and `docker build --pull -t jaina-voice-sidecar /tmp/jaina/JainaVoiceSidecar`.
- Added a shared-network section: `docker network create jaina-net`, both containers' Network Type set to jaina-net, bot reaches sidecar at http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080 via Docker DNS (container name).
- Sidecar container env: TOKEN (same bot token; Discord permits a second connection), PORT (default 8080), SIDECAR_TOKEN (optional; must equal the bot's Bot__SidecarToken).
- Bot container env: TOKEN, DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT, GEMINI_API_KEY, Bot__SidecarBaseUrl=http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080, optional Bot__SidecarToken.
- States NO external ports are published for either container (reached by container name on jaina-net; bot/sidecar only make outbound Discord connections). Force-Update step covers both containers.

== README.md (targeted edits, other sections intact) ==
- /askjaina command bullet + Ask Jaina section: the bot no longer joins voice; it POSTs the synthesized WAV to the sidecar's /play endpoint, which joins, plays, and leaves.
- Added Bot:SidecarBaseUrl (env Bot__SidecarBaseUrl, default http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080) and Bot:SidecarToken (env Bot__SidecarToken, optional X-Sidecar-Token shared secret, must match sidecar SIDECAR_TOKEN) to the config-keys list.
- 'Native runtime dependencies' rewritten: bot needs NO native voice libs (libopus/libsodium/ffmpeg/libdave.so all removed), runs on stock Discord.Net 3.20.2; voice playback handled by the sidecar (links JainaVoiceSidecar/README.md) which bundles ffmpeg + libdave.so; for `dotnet run` the sidecar must be reachable at Bot:SidecarBaseUrl.
- 'Containers And Deployment' updated to two containers on a shared Docker network reached by container name, no published ports, both built from GitHub source on Unraid.

== CONSISTENCY ==
Env var names match FEAT-001 (TOKEN/PORT/SIDECAR_TOKEN) and FEAT-002 (Bot__SidecarBaseUrl / Bot__SidecarToken, default http://jaina-voice-sidecar:8080). /play contract description (POST, guildId/channelId, raw WAV, X-Sidecar-Token) matches JainaVoiceSidecar/README.md and FEAT-001's findings. Build subdirs match context.json.

== VERIFICATION RUN (this commit) ==
- `grep -rn "DAVE-PR-3288" Unraid.md README.md`: NO matches (expected). Also confirmed no remaining 'patched'/'local-packages'/'EnableVoiceDaveEncryption' references; the only libopus/libsodium mentions are the explicit 'these are gone' statements, not install instructions.
- Manual read-through: build commands name both the JainaProudmoore and JainaVoiceSidecar subdirs; env var names match the sidecar and bot; shared-network (jaina-net) + container-name (jaina-voice-sidecar:8080) reachability and no-published-ports are described in both docs. PASS.
